title: BookingFlow
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column with verticalScroll, androidx.activity.compose.BackHandler; MonarchStepper (compact), MonarchRadioRow, MonarchSlotPicker (with its MonarchTimezoneSelect), MonarchTextField, MonarchDescriptionList, MonarchButton and MonarchEmptyState for the confirmation
summary: A recipe, not a component: booking an appointment one step per screen (service, date and time, details, review), with a compact stepper, Back and Continue, and a confirmation.
whenToUse: For a customer booking a service, a call or a visit in the app, when it takes more than one choice.
whenNotToUse: To move an existing booking use the reschedule-dialog recipe; for one choice of time on its own use MonarchSlotPicker directly.
api: MonarchStepper(steps = …, current = step, compact = MonarchStepperCompactMode.Always, onSelect = { _, index -> if (index < step) step = index })
MonarchText(text = title, modifier = Modifier.semantics { liveRegion = LiveRegionMode.Polite }, style = MonarchTextStyle.Heading, heading = true)
MonarchSlotPicker(slots = …, selection = slot, onSelectionChange = …, day = …, onDayChange = …, timeZone = zone, previousMonthIcon = …, nextMonthIcon = …, onTimeZoneChange = { zone = it })
MonarchButton(text = "Back", …, variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Ghost); MonarchButton(text = if (last) "Confirm booking" else "Continue", …, variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Primary, enabled = complete)

options.name: steps
options.description: The steps, in order; leave out those that do not apply (one service: no service step).

options.name: step
options.description: The current step, in rememberSaveable state.

options.name: complete
options.description: Whether Continue is enabled for the current step.

options.name: submit
options.description: What Confirm booking does: book, then show the confirmation; on failure show a MonarchBanner above the buttons.

options.name: confirmation
options.description: What replaces the steps once the booking is made.

states.name: a step
states.description: Stepper summary (Step 2 of 4), the step's heading, its content and Back and Continue.

states.name: incomplete
states.description: Continue is disabled until the step has what it needs.

states.name: submitting / failed
states.description: Show loading on the confirm button and a danger MonarchBanner on failure.

appearance: Existing Monarch components on the screen background: the compact stepper, a heading, radio rows, the slot picker, text fields, a description list and a ghost Back with a primary Continue. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow from those components.
platformNotes: The web ships BookingFlow as a pattern component with steps, step, onStepChange, onSubmit, submitLabel, confirmation, completed, pending, error and messages, plus a useBookingFlow hook, a progress list and a summary panel beside the steps on wide screens. On a phone it is a recipe: one step per screen with the compact MonarchStepper, the system back gesture going to the previous step through BackHandler, and the summary as the last step. Completed steps can be reopened from the stepper (onSelect) instead of Change buttons. A wide window can show the summary in a supporting pane.
accessibility: Each step's heading has heading semantics and sits in a polite live region, so moving between steps is announced.
The stepper reads its position (Step 2 of 4) and completed steps; reached steps are buttons.
Back is a button and also the system back gesture.
Continue is disabled, not hidden, until the step is complete.
Radio rows and the slot picker carry their own selected states.
edgeCases: A service that has no choices: leave its step out.
Changing the day clears the chosen time.
At the largest text sizes each step scrolls while the buttons stay at the bottom.
Keep the state in rememberSaveable so rotation keeps the person's place.
